payload.text: ISSUE:0302 (cc): IN ONLY IF K0120 or the cut's legs show a guessed-identity red (vc's triage, 2026-11-01 18:43Z); otherwise it waits with its placement. Its fix: the harness's GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL points at a file holding [user] useConfigOnly = true (harness.bats's pin with it), so an arm leaning on a guessed identity goes red on every host, as kovacs's matts@kovacs.(none) found; test_helper.bash's comment says where a fixture project's identity comes from; the redundant -c pairs in git_project's callers go. Its run is the whole suite.
